description: Named crop seasons of the satellite page, PER COUNTRY: a location uses them only when its country (Breedbase location country) is listed here; the names are those of sgn.conf available_seasons. A field's season is named by the window its sowing falls in (month-day, a window may cross the new year); with a period of 300 days or more the maize map of such a location is also made per season. Elsewhere (other countries, the other hemisphere, no country) seasons are found in each field's curve but only numbered, with no calendar assumption. Add a country with its own windows when needed.

Brazil.source: Typical national windows of maize in Brazil after the Conab planting and harvest calendar (Calendario de Plantio e Colheita de Graos no Brasil): 1st crop (summer) sown August-December, harvested January-June; 2nd crop (safrinha) sown January-April after the summer soybean, harvested May-September; 3rd / winter crop sown April-July. State calendars differ by a few weeks.
